input.title: Northbrew Coffee loyalty card page (mobile)
input.brief: A mobile-first loyalty card web page for Northbrew Coffee. 1) Sign-up page: a customer enters their email and gets a personal QR code plus a card view showing their stamps (out of 10). 2) Stamp scanning: a staff-only view that scans the customer's QR code with the phone camera and adds one stamp; the 10th coffee is flagged as free and the card resets after it's redeemed. The QR code should hold only a random ID that the server checks, never the stamp count. Must work well on iOS and Android phones (375px wide and up). Deliver a live URL and a public repo.

events.name: post_job

events.text: I posted the job on Verdikt for $400–$700, due in 7 days. The scope is just the email sign-up page with a QR code and stamp card, plus a staff screen that scans the code to add stamps, with the tenth coffee free. Since the budget is well below the usual price, applications might be slow or few, so I'll check them later and let you know who has applied.
